build_default_anchor_generator: build a DefaultAnchorGenerator with custom sizes, aspect ratios, and strides for Faster R-CNN feature maps
build_rotated_anchor_generator: build a RotatedAnchorGenerator with sizes, aspect ratios, strides, and angles for rotated region proposals
generate_cell_anchors_default: generate canonical cell anchors centered at origin with given sizes and aspect ratios in XYXY format
generate_cell_anchors_rotated: generate canonical rotated cell anchors with sizes, aspect ratios, and angles in center format
build_anchor_generator_from_config: build an anchor generator from a Detectron2 config using the ANCHOR_GENERATOR_REGISTRY and input shape
